description: The lambda's database - its records, shared by every version: whether it is switched on, how full it is, and its tables and views with their columns and how many rows each holds. With table, a page of that table's rows, newest first, up to 100 at a time. Read only: the lambda writes it, through Database.GetConnection(). Use it to see that migrations were applied and records were written. With feature, that feature's copy.

ascending.description: Oldest or smallest first, rather than newest or largest.

feature.description: Read this feature's copy of the database instead.

limit.description: Rows to read, up to 100. Left out, 20.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page.

order.description: A column to sort by; left out, the order the rows were written in.

privateKey.description: The editor key, or the key of a demo.

table.description: A table or view to read the rows of; left out, the tables are listed.

name: read_database
title: Read the lambda's database
